info.name: DLMS Dashboard Admin & Employee API
info.description: SYRTAK / DLMS official dashboard authentication, RBAC, and employee management.

item.name: 04 - Employee Management
item.description: Query params for GET /dashboard/employees: search, role_id, is_active (0|1), page, per_page (10|20|25|50), sort_by (name|email|created_at), sort_direction (asc|desc), optional user_type (admin|employee). Response includes items, pagination (with from/to), statistics, and role_options. Auth: Bearer {{dashboard_token}} or {{super_admin_token}}. Permission: manage_employees.

request.description: Default list. per_page defaults to 20. Returns items, pagination, statistics, role_options.
Existing roles endpoint (permission: view_roles). List employees also embeds data.role_options with id, name, display_name.
Sets is_active=true. Idempotent if already active. Audit: employee.activated
Sets is_active=false. Blocks self-deactivation and last active super_admin. Audit: employee.deactivated
Legacy. Prefer activate/deactivate. Optional body is_active true|false; omit to flip.

item.name: 07 - Dashboard Overview
item.description:
GET /dashboard/overview — permission-aware home dashboard aggregates.

Auth: Bearer {{dashboard_token}} (auth:sanctum + dashboard middleware). No manage_settings required.

Timestamps: DATETIME values are stored in UTC (APP_TIMEZONE=UTC). Overview calendar periods use BUSINESS_TIMEZONE (Asia/Damascus). meta.timezone is the business timezone (Asia/Damascus), not APP_TIMEZONE.

licenses_ready_for_issuance uses LicenseIssuanceEligibilityService (same rules as POST /admin/applications/{id}/issue-license):
- Explicit issuable codes only: new_license, renew_license, lost_replacement, damaged_replacement
- Excludes license_unblock (use POST /admin/licenses/{id}/unblock)
- Excludes unknown/custom service codes (fail-closed)
- Requires approved status, completed fee payment, approved required documents, passed required tests when applicable, no unpaid fines
- Excludes already-issued applications (License row exists)

applications.pending_action may include approved apps that are not yet ready for issuance; ready-for-issuance is a subset — do not sum overlapping queues.

Query: period (7d|30d|90d|12m), recent_limit (1–10), activity_limit (1–10).

request.description: Default period=30d, recent_limit=5, activity_limit=8. Sections included only when the token holder has the corresponding permissions.

query.description: Current day + previous 6 calendar days. trend_granularity=day.
Current day + previous 29 calendar days. Default.
Current month + previous 11 months. trend_granularity=month. Buckets YYYY-MM.

request.description: Expect HTTP 422. Allowed: 7d, 30d, 90d, 12m.
No Authorization header. Expect HTTP 401. Citizen tokens expect HTTP 403 (dashboard middleware).

item.name: Reports & Statistics
item.description:
Dashboard Reports API under /dashboard/reports.

Auth: Bearer {{dashboard_token}} — keep empty; no real token.
Base permission: view_reports + access_dashboard.
Domain permissions apply per endpoint (applications, payments, fines, etc.).

Shared query params:
- period: 7d|30d|90d|12m|custom
- date_from, date_to (required when period=custom; max 366 days)
- group_by: auto|day|week|month
- page, per_page (max 100) on drill-down endpoints

Financial sections: application payments only (fine_id IS NULL, status=completed). Amounts are decimal strings. Currencies are never mixed.
Fines report is separate from application payment revenue.

Legacy GET /admin/reports/overview remains for backward compatibility (deprecated).

request.description: Authoritative filter labels. Options are permission-filtered.
Permission-aware KPI sections with visibility object.
Requires view_applications OR manage_applications.
Separate from application payments. Requires view_fines OR manage_fines.
Requires manage_employees OR view_employees. Audit metrics need view_audit_logs.

item.name: 08 - Dashboard Document Review
item.description:
Dashboard Document Review APIs (auth:sanctum + dashboard + permission:review_documents).

Auth: Bearer {{dashboard_token}} — keep empty; do not store a real token.

Default queue scope: review_status=awaiting_review (applications in documents_under_review with at least one pending_review document).

Search fields: application_number, citizen name only. Phone / email / national_id are NOT searchable and are NOT returned in queue rows.

Queue citizen shape: { id, name } only.

Ordering: FIFO by COALESCE(submitted_at, created_at) ASC, then id ASC.

Stats units (all application counts):
- awaiting_review: applications awaiting document review
- completed_documents: applications that left document-review stage (post-review statuses) — name is historical; unit is applications
- late_requests: awaiting-review applications older than 3 days
- reupload_required: applications in documents_rejected

Reject payload (Dashboard):
{
  "rejection_reason_code": "unclear_document|wrong_document|expired_document|incomplete_document|other",
  "rejection_details": "optional except required when code=other (max 2000)"
}

Preview is authenticated inline binary (PDF/JPEG/PNG). No public URL. No storage paths in JSON.

Legacy admin POST /admin/documents/{id}/reject still accepts free-text rejection_reason.

request.description: Default review_status=awaiting_review. No phone/email/national_id in items.

query.description: Matches application_number or citizen name only.

request.description: All keys are application counts (see folder description).
Includes summary, header, documents (latest active versions), actions, rejection_reasons Combobox options, structured rejection on rejected docs.
Authenticated inline binary. Allowed: PDF, JPEG, PNG. Content-Disposition: inline. No public URL.
No body. Stale/already-reviewed → 422. Final required approval → payment_pending.
Expect HTTP 422 on rejection_reason_code.
Expect HTTP 422 on rejection_details.
Call after the document was already approved/rejected. Expect HTTP 422 Arabic business conflict.
Expect HTTP 401.
Use a dashboard token without review_documents. Expect HTTP 403. Citizens also get 403.

item.name: 09 - Dashboard Citizen Management
item.description:
Dashboard Citizen Management APIs (auth:sanctum + dashboard + permission:manage_users).

Scope: Citizens only (user_type=citizen). Employees and admins are NEVER returned — use 404 instead of 403 to avoid disclosing account type.

Auth: Bearer {{dashboard_token}} — keep empty; do not store a real token.

Search fields (unified): name, national_id, phone, email — OR grouped, always within citizen scope.

Filters: is_active (0/1/true/false), profile_status (incomplete|pending_review|approved|rejected).

Pagination: page + per_page (1-100, default 20). Server-side deterministic order: id DESC.

Stats: global citizen aggregation counts — not filter-scoped.

Deactivation effects:
- is_active → false
- deactivated_at, deactivated_by, deactivation_reason stored
- All citizen Sanctum tokens deleted immediately
- Citizen cannot login until reactivated
- Pending applications/licenses/fines remain unchanged

Activation effects:
- is_active → true, deactivation metadata cleared
- No token is issued automatically — citizen must log in again

Idempotency:
- Deactivating already-inactive citizen → 200 (no new audit, no new notification, remaining tokens revoked)
- Activating already-active citizen → 200 (no new audit, no new notification)

Audit logs (GET /{citizen}/audit-logs) additionally requires view_audit_logs permission.

Removed routes (do not document):
- POST /dashboard/citizens (create — citizens self-register)
- DELETE /dashboard/citizens/{id} (hard-delete — not supported)

request.description:
Returns paginated list of citizens.

Response shape per item:
{
  id, name, national_id, phone, email,
  is_active (bool),
  account_status: { value: 'active'|'inactive', label },
  profile_status (raw string),
  profile_status_info: { value, label },
  created_at
}

Pagination: { current_page, per_page, total, last_page }
Searches name, national_id, phone, email — OR grouped, always citizen-scoped.
Valid values: incomplete | pending_review | approved | rejected
Returns [{ value, label }] for all ProfileStatus enum values.

Allowed fields: name, email, phone, national_id, birth_date, governorate, address.

NOT allowed (silently ignored or rejected):
- is_active (use /activate or /deactivate)
- user_type
- password
- roles / permissions
- deactivation metadata

Unique validation ignores the current citizen (but collisions with other users return 422).

Returns the updated citizen details.

No body required.

Transactional + lockForUpdate.

Idempotent: already-active citizen returns 200 without audit or notification.

Does NOT issue a new token — citizen must log in again.

Payload: { reason: required string max 1000 }

Transactional + lockForUpdate.

Effects:
- is_active → false
- deactivated_at, deactivated_by, deactivation_reason stored
- ALL citizen Sanctum tokens deleted
- citizen.deactivated audit created
- Activation notification sent after commit

Idempotent: already-inactive citizen returns 200, remaining tokens revoked, no new audit/notification, original reason preserved.

Requires manage_users AND view_audit_logs permissions.

Returns citizen-management actions only:
- citizen.updated
- citizen.activated
- citizen.deactivated

Paginated (default 20, max 100).
Expect HTTP 422 with validation error on profile_status.
Missing reason → 422. Blank reason → 422.
No Authorization header. Expect HTTP 401.

Accessing an employee or admin ID through the citizen endpoint returns 404. Avoids disclosing account type.

item.name: 10 - Dashboard Financial Operations
item.description:
Dashboard Financial Operations (application payments only).

Auth: Bearer {{dashboard_token}} — keep empty; no real token.
Permissions: view_payments OR manage_payments for reads; manage_payments for verify; view_audit_logs for audit-logs.

Scope:
- Application fee payment attempts only (fine_id IS NULL).
- Fines remain a separate module.
- No refunds, no mark-paid, no delete, no amount edit, no manual status change.

Amounts are decimal strings (e.g. "50.00").
Currency: USD for new application fees and payments. Historical currencies may appear in legacy rows.
Stripe currency must match Fee/Payment currency exactly — no conversion.

Verify = provider reconciliation, not administrative approval.
under_verification = financial conflict/uncertain provider result; not collected revenue.

request.description: Paginated application-payment attempts. Excludes fines.
completed_amount is collected revenue only. pending/failed/under_verification are not revenue. Fines excluded.
Applications in payment_pending with unresolved fee obligation (no completed payment for that application+fee).
Privacy-safe details. No metadata/checkout URL/secrets. Fine-linked IDs → 404.
Requires view_audit_logs in addition to payment read permission.
Requires manage_payments. No body. Asks Stripe for authoritative status. Mock returns 422 unsupported.
Use a token with view_payments only.
Successful Dashboard login creates a linked employee session.
Any authenticated Dashboard employee. No client-controlled lifecycle fields.
Normal Admin / employee tokens must receive 403.
Expect 409 when already revoked/logged out/expired.
